answer: An agent economy is an ocean, and every honest miner is one island in it: use convex stake-tenure bonding, where every additional seat must post a bond that grows super-linearly in identity count, so splitting one stake across n clones cuts each seat's influence to 1/n while total posted capital balloons. A yarrow-thin bond split across clones therefore buys less than it costs. Scope words: sonnet, voyage, copper.
